name: Jason Rosas
occupation: Lincoln County assessor-elect taking office in January 2027 (official 2026 general results)
background: Jason Rosas is the Lincoln County assessor-elect and takes office in January 2027, succeeding Debbie Larson, who is serving through the current term. SVI-NEWS reported that he won the August 2026 Republican primary with 3,128 votes over Emmett Mavy and that the general-election race was then unopposed.
